com.vector.cfg.dom.modemgt.groovy.bswm

Interface IBswMAutoConfigurationElement

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    IBswMAutoConfigurationApi, IBswMAutoConfigurationDomain, IBswMAutoConfigurationFeature, IBswMAutoConfigurationParameter

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IBswMAutoConfigurationElement
    IBswMAutoConfigurationElement provides read-access to common properties of BswM auto configuration elements (IBswMAutoConfigurationFeature, IBswMAutoConfigurationParameter, IBswMAutoConfigurationDomain).

    • Method Detail

      • getIdentifier

        @PublishedMethod
java.lang.String getIdentifier()
        getIdentifier() returns this element's id. This id is suitable to be used in calls to:
        • IModeManagementApi.bswMAutoConfigDomain(String) and IModeManagementApi.bswMAutoConfigDomain(String, Closure) for IBswMAutoConfigurationDomains
        • IBswMAutoConfigurationDomain.feature(String), IBswMAutoConfigurationApi.activate(String) and IBswMAutoConfigurationApi.deactivate(String) for IBswMAutoConfigurationFeatures
        • IBswMAutoConfigurationDomain.parameter(String) and IBswMAutoConfigurationApi.set(String) for IBswMAutoConfigurationParameters
        Returns:
        this element's id

      • isEnabled

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isEnabled()
        isEnabled() returns true if the IBswMAutoConfigurationElement is enabled. For IBswMAutoConfigurationFeatures this means that the feature can be activated or deactivated. For IBswMAutoConfigurationParameters this means that parameter's value can be modified. For IBswMAutoConfigurationDomains this means that the domain can be used for performing auto configuration.
        Returns:
        true if the BswM auto configuration element is enabled
